name: Shadow Lifesteal
description: A shadow affinity that marks, drains and consumes enemy life force, then converts it into power.

abilities.name: Umbral Mark
abilities.description: Mark the nearest enemy. Marked targets take increased lifesteal damage.

abilities.name: Shadow Leech
abilities.description: Fire a shadow tether at the nearest enemy, dealing damage and restoring health.

abilities.name: Nightfall Harvest
abilities.description: Release a circular shadow pulse. Heal for each enemy caught in the area.

abilities.name: Wraith Step
abilities.description: Dash through darkness, leaving a damaging afterimage.

abilities.name: Eclipse Ascendant
abilities.description: Surround yourself in a shaded violet aura; boost damage, defence, movement speed and regeneration for 12 seconds.
